name: rating-breakdown-field
title: Rating breakdown field
description: Rate several things at once, such as Cleanliness, Location and Value, with stars per row, a Not applicable option and the overall average.
docs: aspects is the list of rows, { id, label, description, required }[]. value and onValueChange speak every answer by the id of its row: a number from 1 to max is a rating, null is Not applicable, and a row that is missing has not been answered; onValueChange gets the whole record. The group is a fieldset named by label (description adds a line under it that says what to do), and each row is a group a screen reader announces by name (Cleanliness, 4 stars); it keeps one tab stop and the arrow keys change the stars. Ticking Not applicable switches the row's stars off and drops its rating. The overall score is the mean of the rows that have a rating, shown with one decimal (locale writes it; a tag that is not a language tag, such as en_US, is read as en-US) and partial stars; until every required row has an answer, where an answer is a rating or Not applicable, it says how many rows are rated (3 of 5 rated) and which are still needed instead of showing a number. Optional rows are marked Optional once at least one row is required, on the page and in the name a screen reader reads. showOverall hides the panel, max sets the number of stars (default 5), and name adds the answers to a plain form submit as <name>-<id>: the rating, or na for Not applicable. A change to the overall score is told to a screen reader once the rating has stopped changing. summarizeRatings and averageRating are plain functions in rating-breakdown-field/ratings.
